items.title: File-type allow-list bypass on /ftp via encoded NUL byte discloses backup files
API accepts unsigned JWT (alg=none), allowing forged identities
Unauthenticated /rest/memories returns full user records including password hashes and deluxe tokens

Any self-registered customer can list all user accounts via GET /api/Users
SQL injection in login email allows authentication bypass as the first (admin) account
Any authenticated customer can read another user's basket by id (BOLA/IDOR)
Mass assignment on user registration lets an anonymous client create an admin account
Password can be changed without knowing the current password (current parameter optional)
Basket accepts negative item quantities, enabling negative order totals
Confidential documents downloadable without authentication from browsable /ftp directory
